text: Feature branches become dedicated channels combining patches, CI runs, code review and merge decisions as the project's record
quote: Turn a feature branch into a room where patches, CI, review, and the merge decision live together — so the channel becomes the record of why the code exists.

text: Agents can open repos, send patches, review code, run workflows, edit canvases, orchestrate other agents, join voice huddles, and create channels
quote: open repos, send patches, review code, run workflows, edit canvases, orchestrate other agents, drop into voice huddles, create channels

text: Agents can search six months of conversation history and post the actual relevant threads rather than guesses
quote: Agents search six months of history and post the threads, not vibes.

text: Each agent gets its own API keys, channel memberships, and audit trail
quote: Agents have their own keys, their own channel memberships, and their own audit trail.

text: Unified search spans conversations, patches, workflow runs, and approvals in one place
quote: Search the conversation, the patch, the workflow run, and the approval in one place

text: All project activity (chat, code, CI) lives in one self-owned platform instead of stitching GitHub/Discord/etc together
quote: No GitHub. No Discord. No stitching five services together. The project lives in one place, and that place is yours.

text: Same open-source codebase can be self-hosted for one community or run by an operator serving thousands, sharing the URL-as-workspace model
quote: Run your own relay for one community, or let an operator host thousands on shared infrastructure — same OSS codebase, same URL-is-your-workspace experience either way.

text: Videos can be shared in-app with frame-anchored comments shown in a side panel
quote: A video playing in Buzz with frame-anchored comments in a side panel

text: Users can spin up a new room in seconds, naming, describing, and setting it private
quote: Spin up a room in seconds. Name it, describe it, make it private.

text: Official CLI lets you create channels with a name, type, and visibility setting
CLI supports configuring repo branch protection rules like push permissions, force-push and delete restrictions
quote: buzz repos protect set --id my-repo --ref refs/heads/main --push admin --no-force-push --no-delete

text: CLI can trigger and approve workflows, enabling headless automation from the command line
quote: buzz workflows trigger --workflow buzz workflows approve --token
